thread.title: Clear Creek County to conduct emergency evacuation exercise on May 2
thread.title_full: Clear Creek County to conduct emergency evacuation exercise on May 2

author: b. n. henning
title: Clear Creek County to conduct emergency evacuation exercise on May 2
text:
Clear Creek County officials announced on April 29 that several neighborhoods along Highway 103 will participate in an emergency evacuation exercise scheduled for Saturday, May 2. The event is expected to cause heavy traffic on Highway 103 between 10 a.m. and 12:30 p.m.
The exercise aims to help residents become more familiar with evacuation routes and procedures, while also allowing participating agencies to improve their response processes. Residents of the Beaver Brook, Echo Hills, Evergreen West, and Raven Ridge neighborhoods have registered for the drill and will receive instructions to evacuate their homes that morning.
All participants are directed to use Highway 103 East toward Evergreen Parkway/Highway 74 South, leading them to the designated evacuation center at the former Bergen Meadow Elementary School. Public safety personnel will monitor checkpoints along the route during the exercise. Variable message boards have been placed on Highway 103 warning motorists about expected delays.
Officials encourage all Clear Creek County residents to sign up for Lookout Alert emergency notifications through www.lookoutalert.com as it is described as “the most effective and efficient way” for residents to receive timely instructions during emergencies such as evacuations or shelter-in-place orders.
Media representatives are invited to observe the exercise by RSVP’ing with Einar Jensen of Evergreen Fire Rescue by Friday, May 1. They are asked to arrive by 9 a.m., park at Bergen Meadow Elementary School, and proceed on foot up the stairs to Evergreen Fire Rescue Station 2.
Participating agencies include Clear Creek Sheriff’s Office, Evergreen Fire Rescue, Clear Creek Fire Authority, Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office, Jeffcom911, and Clear Creek County itself. For questions about the event or media arrangements, contact Einar Jensen or Jenny Fulton from Clear Creek Sheriff’s Office.
